clauses.reason: Establishment, five private-sector members and designation of the Chairman are all features of the Commission that terminates under amended section 4(b).
Advice to AID and progress reports to the Deputy Secretary of State are Commission functions. The prior statutory commission's May 16, 1992 end is contextual, not this Commission's ending.
AID funding is specifically funding for this Commission and has no separate prospective authorization once it ends.
Uncompensated service and statutory travel expenses are tied to work on the Commission. Existing travel claims may accrue; no new Commission work follows the amended sunset.
Reimbursable administrative services require this Commission's Chairman's request and AID's judgment, so the prospective authority depends on this Commission.
Procurement authority belongs to the Commission Chairman through AID and concerns temporary/intermittent services; it does not set up a continuing independent procurement program.
The FACA delegation to AID is expressly for functions applicable to this Commission and ceases prospectively with that body.

EO12815 expressly substitutes December 31, 1992 for September 30, 1992. The substituted not-later-than sunset closes the Commission absent evidence of a legally earlier ending; no report date or amendment signing date is used as an end.

savings.reason: Already accrued travel reimbursements and liabilities from properly procured Commission services may persist; no particular transaction is asserted. They are residual accrued matters. The original and EO12869 provide no independent continuing AID advisory, reporting or administrative command for this Commission after its amended sunset.

research_rationale: The machine's lone whole clause is only header material, so all eight operative sections/subsections are reconstructed from the frozen complete original exact spans. EO12815 changes section 4(b)'s September 30 date to December 31, 1992. Neither the earlier statutory predecessor commission nor the original superseded September date ends this Commission. No earlier termination act is held or identified by the bounded later-event search; December 31 is the amended self-executing outer sunset. Advice, progress reporting, funding, travel, support, procurement and FACA administration all attach to this Commission. EO12869 section 4(b), effective September 30, 1993 under section 6, subsequently revokes the order but does not establish its first functional ending. The selected original text is complete on its face and its bytes/provenance are pinned; page-image authentication is not claimed. Searches are accepted only for the bounded contrary-evidence task through the specified cutoff, not as substantive proof of an operative current predicate.
